Vendored web fonts — license notice
====================================

All font families in this directory are distributed under the SIL Open Font
License, version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org/), which permits bundling
and redistribution, including in this project.

Families and sources (fetched from the Google Fonts CSS API, Google's own
distribution of the upstream OFL-licensed font files):

- JetBrains Mono   — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono
- Outfit            — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit
- Crimson Pro       — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Crimson+Pro
- Inter             — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter
- Source Sans 3     — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Source+Sans+3
- Lato              — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Lato

Crimson Pro, Inter, Source Sans 3, and Lato were added to support the named
HTML export templates in _extensions/4dpaper/export_templates.py (academic,
modern, compact, preprint). Files are the latin-subset .woff2 faces at the
weights/styles each template uses:

- Crimson Pro:   400 normal, 600 normal, 400 italic
- Inter:         400, 500, 600, 700 (normal)
- Source Sans 3: 400, 600 (normal)
- Lato:          400 normal, 700 normal, 400 italic

No modifications were made to the font files themselves.
